q.en: "The government wants to improve the ___ rate in rural areas."
q.bn: "The government wants to improve the ___ rate in rural areas."

why.en: "Literacy rate" is the fixed collocation (the noun form). "Literate" is an adjective describing a person, not a rate.
why.bn: "Literacy rate" fixed collocation (noun form)। "Literate" একটা adjective, একটা মানুষকে বর্ণনা করে, rate-কে না।

q.en: "She finally ___ as a doctor last year."
q.bn: "She finally ___ as a doctor last year."

why.en: "Qualified" is the past simple of the verb "qualify" — needed here because the sentence is about a completed past action ("last year").
why.bn: "Qualified" হলো verb "qualify"-এর past simple form — এখানে লাগবে কারণ sentence-টা একটা শেষ হওয়া past action ("last year") নিয়ে।

q.en: "___ training prepares someone for a specific trade, not an academic degree."
q.bn: "___ training prepares someone for a specific trade, not an academic degree."

why.en: "Vocational training" means practical, job-specific training, as opposed to an academic degree.
why.bn: "Vocational training" মানে practical, job-specific training — academic degree-এর বিপরীতে।

q.en: What is the opposite of "state school"?

why.en: A state school is government-funded and free; a private school charges fees.
why.bn: State school government-funded এবং free; private school fee নেয়।

why.en: "Disadvantaged" describes people with fewer resources or opportunities than their peers — it's an adjective for people, not a verb or a quality level.
why.bn: "Disadvantaged" এমন মানুষদের বর্ণনা করে যাদের সমবয়সীদের চেয়ে কম resource বা সুযোগ আছে — এটা মানুষের জন্য adjective, verb বা quality-level না।
